thread:
maya: heads up — after rolling driver 535.54 -> 536.02 to a 10% canary, we saw a small uptick in Xid 13 on nv cards in eu-west-1 this morning :thinking_face:
sam: can you paste the minimal log scrub? how many hosts affected?
maya: ~6 hosts, all p4d-type. sample log snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T07:12:04Z] kernel: NVRM: Xid (13) at 0xabcdef (Error: ecc mem)
[2026-03-18T07:12:04Z] nvidia: GPU0: ECC errors rising from 0 -> 4 in 2m
```
maya: no other user-facing errors, jobs auto-restarted by drain policy.
infra-bot: canary-checker report attached — baseline Xid rate: 0.1/hr, canary batch: 0.8/hr, p-value 0.04. see /internal/canary/2065436789
liam: interesting — did we change any kernel module flags with 536.02?
anya: not that I saw; packaging only swapped a driver .ko binary and updated udev rules for reboot ordering.
sam: ok let's not panic. plan: 1) run targeted sentinel burnin on the 6 hosts to repro 2) collect full ECC counters + dmesg + nv-lsmi 3) run a small rollback for 2 hosts to 535.54 to compare.
maya: sounds good. I've already kicked off `./infra/scripts/sentinel-burnin --hosts host[101-106] --duration 4h --workload mem-stress --sample-interval 60s`
sam: thanks. once the burnin finishes, upload artifacts to the triage bucket and tag with `xid-2065436789`. can you also run `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,DRIVER` every 5m?
liam: I'll prepare a bisect set in case we need kernel/driver combos. possible suspects: microcode/firmware mismatch or a new kernel ABI touch.
anya: for cost/fragility note: running burnin on 6 hosts will push reserved capacity usage — we have room for 2 hours then need to shift jobs. tagging @oncall so they're aware.
maya: infra-bot pushed an automated snapshot before the burnin: snapshot id snap-2065436789.
infra-bot: sentinel job started on hosts host101..host106; expected finish 2026-03-18T11:12:00Z. Logs streaming to /logs/sentinel/2065436789
sam: if burnin reproduces Xid, next steps: collect hw logs, schedule replacement/eviction for persistent cards, and open an infra postmortem if p-value stays < 0.05 after rollback comparison.
liam: if rollback drops Xid to baseline, we should consider holding driver 535.54 for eu-west-1 and open a gating ticket for further testing on the next driver candidate.
anya: adding quick checklist:
- run sentinel burnin (maya)
- collect nv-smi, dmesg, ECC counters (maya, sam)
- rollback 2 hosts and compare (sam)
- bisect driver/kernel combos (liam)
- inform oncall and schedule replacement if persistent (anya)
maya: noted. I'll post interim update when the burnin hits the first Xid or completes. :mag_right:
sam: thanks — let's keep updates short here. if anyone sees a region-wide spike, ping #incidents.
